requirement.description: The cache_configure function does not emit deprecation warnings when deprecated parameters (ip_address_size and host_validate_size) are used, causing test failures in test_cache_configure_waring.
requirement.contract: The cache_configure function must emit a DeprecationWarning when ip_address_size or host_validate_size parameters are passed, indicating these parameters are deprecated and will be removed in the future. The warning message should clearly state that these parameters are deprecated and replaced by encode_host_size.

requirement.description: The cache_configure function doesn't properly handle the combination of deprecated and new parameters, leading to test failures in test_cache_configure_None_including_deprecated.
requirement.contract: The cache_configure function should accept deprecated parameters (ip_address_size and host_validate_size) alongside new ones (encode_host_size), properly mapping the deprecated parameters to the new parameter for backward compatibility.

requirement.description: Some URL parsing tests fail due to missing or incorrect implementation of host validation and normalization logic.
requirement.contract: URL parsing functions must correctly handle various host formats including IPv6 addresses, IDNA encoding, and special cases like trailing dots in hostnames.

requirement.description: The cache_configure function does not correctly handle parameter combinations that should trigger deprecation warnings.
requirement.contract: When deprecated parameters (ip_address_size or host_validate_size) are used, the function must emit DeprecationWarning with the appropriate message. When both deprecated and new parameters are used, the deprecated ones should be ignored but still trigger warnings.

requirement.description: Missing or incorrect handling of cache configuration parameters in cache_configure function leads to test failures.
requirement.contract: The cache_configure function must properly process all accepted parameters (idna_encode_size, idna_decode_size, ip_address_size, host_validate_size, encode_host_size) with appropriate deprecation handling and caching behavior.
